# Vibe Prospecting

Skills that teach agents to work with Vibe Prospecting. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [explorium-ai/vibeprospecting-plugin](https://github.com/explorium-ai/vibeprospecting-plugin), at commit `ca43f6d`.

B2B data for lead lists, company research and outreach with Vibe Prospecting.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Vibe Prospecting**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Vibe Prospecting**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install vibe-prospecting@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skills: `vibe-prospecting`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skill refers to an API key in `VP_API_KEY`. The plugin does not store it.

The vendor's slash command `skip_sample` is not included.
